title: Record the CEO's 25,000-line core limit
goal: The CEO set a new core size limit on 2026-11-18: "core under 25k". Record it in Mandate 84 and every text and check that states the limit, in both repositories: the complete socket stays strictly below 25,000 physical runtime Rust lines (at most 24,999). The ceiling drops to the measured size now and only goes down; cargo core-size checks the new limit and fails until it is met. No functionality is dropped.
